statement: Create src/lib/nav/stack-model.ts, a pure module with no imports from React or the DOM, exporting stackModel(input) where input is { armed: { id, title, state, intervals: Array<{ startedAt: string, endedAt: string | null }> } | null, earlier: Array<{ id, title, state, intervals }>, queues: Array<{ id, label, tableId }>, now: string }. It returns { bands: [ { kind: 'now', block }, { kind: 'earlier', blocks }, { kind: 'queues', queues }, { kind: 'find' } ] } in exactly that order, where each block carries elapsedMs = the SUM of its interval lengths (endedAt null means running until now), earlier blocks sorted newest-first by their last interval start, and a helper resumeBlock(model, id) that returns { arm: id, park: previousArmedId | null }. Write src/lib/nav/stack-model.test.ts with node:test covering band order, summed intervals across a parked gap, newest-first ordering, resume parks the current block, and an empty input. Touch no other file.
routerHint: pure model stack bands now earlier queues find work_sessions intervals elapsed sum resume park node:test
